_comment: scripts/unreached-source-scan.mjs: a file under crates/<crate>/src that the compiler never reads. Each entry is a **decision** (an asset the crate really embeds, or a deliberate draft kept out of the build), which is the one thing a reader cannot re-derive from the tree — so the reason lives here, next to the entry. A reason is required, and an entry whose path is no longer reported fails as stale (a suppression that outlives its cause hides the next regression). **The list is empty on purpose**: the one entry it ever had (`crates/amos-media/src/protocol.rs`, REQ-A459) was consumed when that draft was activated into the build — the gate reported it stale, which is exactly what the stale rule is for. An empty array here means 'no file is excused', not 'nobody looked'.
